## Checklist

- [ ] The resource describes, evaluates, or bounds a self-improvement loop, and is from 2022 or later.
- [ ] The link is the canonical primary source (published proceedings over a preprint; arXiv `abs/` over PDF), and the entry name matches its title.
- [ ] I searched the README, issues, and pull requests for duplicates.
- [ ] The entry is in the single best-fitting section, after the other entries of its year, with one neutral sentence in the format from [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/natnew/awesome-recursive-self-improvement/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#entry-format).
- [ ] `npm test` passes, or I am relying on CI to run it.
